title: nasturtium incisum
intro: Nasturtium incisum, commonly known as Indian cress or small flower cress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its edible flowers and leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for their various health benefits. The health benefits of Nasturtium incisum include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Nasturtium incisum include glucosinolates, which have been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory effects.
